title: Arkret Contact and Direct Conversation Operation DTOs
description: Closed request/response DTO bundle for the Contact lifecycle: request, respond, reject, scope replacement, tombstone, the portable Contact round evidence bundle, acceptance receipts and the peer Contact carrier, plus the contact-list projection.

recipient.description: Exact Contact participant receiving this private delivery. The delivery Station is derived from the human account_id.station_id or the agent controller_account_id.station_id and is not carried as a parallel identity field.

service_resolution.description: First-hop transport material for the Station derived from recipient.

route_assistance.description: Optional transport-only hints for recovering the same recipient_id route during Contact delivery bootstrap. They are not part of the signed Contact Event, Contact projection, Realm member current state or authority state; they do not extend any token/receipt TTL or authorize delivery.

sorted_pair_member_ids.description: Exactly two distinct full ActorIds, strictly ascending by their RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 unsigned bytes. Validation rejects noncanonical order without sorting the received array.
Exactly two distinct full ActorIds, strictly ascending by their RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 unsigned bytes. Validation rejects noncanonical order without sorting the received array.

requests.description: Exactly two distinct request_event_ref values, strictly ascending by the complete typed EventId wire string UTF-8 unsigned bytes. Receipt digest is not a sort key or tiebreaker. Duplicate refs are invalid even with different digests. Receivers reject unsorted input without normalization. The signed request Event author ActorId of requests[0], not the Station receipt issuer_id, is the root-round founder.

current_operations.description: Exactly one original confirmed head operation for each opposite directional proof. Scope origins and round Events alone do not necessarily contain the latest head.

contact_round_evidence_bundle.description: Current normal/glare establishment plus immutable first identity and two opposite directional currents. No intermediate round chain. The first identity determines founder; current scope instances authorize separately.

contact_current_proof.description: Complete source-authenticated directional current at one durable cut. Only a new committed holder operation advances version; establishment, peer closure and proof refresh do not. Same-version conflicts compare immutable operation bytes, not proof bytes. Refresh never replaces known closures. The expected Station is independently derived from holder; no shared tombstone head or per-round completeness chain.

contact_lineage.description: Source-confirmed exact holder operation projection. issuer is the complete holder ContactPeer, not the signing Station. version is monotonic for holder/peer/trust-domain across all Contact operations and rounds. contact_round_id exists only for post-establishment operations. Original accepted_at and producer descriptor remain immutable.

request_message.description: The exact verified request Event message, present only for pending_incoming and only when that Event carries message.

effective_scopes.description: Optional shorthand. When present, MUST equal bidirectional_scopes.

contact_next_prepare_input.description: Server-provided exact next operation cursor: same contact_round_id, version=current lifetime holder direction version+1 and predecessor_event_ref=own exact current operation head. Copy verbatim; do not derive from list summary refs. Accepted rows carry it; pending/terminal rows do not. Normal requester and glare heads are their original requests, without synthetic accepted Events.

contact_scope_update_payload.description: Holder full-set replacement in a nonterminal established round. version advances the holder lifetime direction, retained scope instances retain their grant Event. Empty scopes remain accepted; pure narrowing does not wait for remote freshness.

block_peer.description: Holder-private commit side effect. true adds the peer to invite receive policy denied_subjects; false only tombstones the Contact lineage. This field is reservation-bound and is not copied into the public Contact Event payload.

direct_conversation_summary.description: Contact-list projection of an already materialized stable Direct Conversation. Coordinates and binding identity are immutable; state only says whether the same conversation is currently sendable. Creation progress is exposed only by direct_conversation_resolve_response_body; there is no durable creation operation, draft or reservation.

subject_id.description: Exact Contact participant whose Station issued this directional attestation.

issuer_id.description: Station service authority that signed this attestation at observed_at.

glare_concurrency_attestation.description: The source durably chooses glare for these exact requests in the same transaction as this attestation. version is the subject request operation version; finalizing glare does not increment it. No cumulative observed Event list, no later normal/reject choice, no unilateral authorizing success.

normal_response_acceptance_receipt.description: Source Station attestation issued only after the exact response Event's command unit is committed and its Contact effect atomically installed. Pending admission or proposal acknowledgement is not this receipt.

response_event_ref.description: Complete identity of the accepted response Event. Its digest is derived by decoding this suite-tagged full-digest EventId; no parallel response_digest is carried.

outgoing_slot_absence_digest.description: H('ak.contact.no_outgoing_slot.v1', outgoing_slot_absence_transcript) over the exact closed transcript defined by identity/contact-and-direct-conversation.md section 2.

peer_contact_authoritative_mirror_receip.description: Only an accepted or duplicate mirror receipt proves that the immutable signed Contact fact is durably mirrored. A deferred receipt is never authority for proof refresh or glare finalization.

control_material_digest.description: H('ak.peer-contact.control-result.v1',{request_digest,state_kind,glare_concurrency_attestation?,current_proof?,material?}) over the exact closed successful result.

peer_contact_control_receipt.description: The recipient signs every field except signature. This receipt is only for current_refresh, glare_finalize or continuity_checkpoint and cannot stand in for a signed Event mirror receipt.

peer_contact_event_submit_response_body.description: Only the five signed Contact Event request kinds use this branch. The receipt event coordinates and state_kind must match the submitted Event exactly. Request/response may return a current proof; accepted or duplicate scope/tombstone must return one; reject and deferred never do.

signed_event_ref.description: Complete identity of the mirrored signed Event. Its digest is derived by decoding this suite-tagged full-digest EventId; request_digest remains the distinct digest of the peer submit request.

peer_contact_submit_request_body.description: Closed Contact-only peer carrier. Each Event branch carries existing source Station attestation of a truly RealmCommit-committed Contact projection; pending admission cannot produce an authorizing receipt or receipted outbox. The original holder producer remains independently authenticated. No private PCR bootstrap, RealmCommit or new confirmation field is carried.

oneOf.description: Exact-pair source-current read with no prior mirror receipt prerequisite. The Message-Signature Station must host requester and may read only the opposite exact participant. Zero known_version is local unknown, not never-written proof. Optional initial identity is an assertion to match, not a caller-selected root. Hidden admission and quota outcomes remain opaque.

reject_acceptance_receipt.description: Source Station attestation of the committed Contact rejection Event, which is a successful terminal domain command. A RealmCommit-rejected command or pending Event cannot produce this receipt.

reject_event_ref.description: Complete identity of the accepted reject Event. Its digest is derived by decoding this suite-tagged full-digest EventId; no parallel reject_digest is carried.

request_acceptance_receipt.description: Source Station attestation issued only after the exact request Event's command unit is committed and its Contact effect atomically installed. It may seed normal/glare round evidence; a pending admission receipt cannot occupy this type.

request_event_ref.description: Complete identity of the accepted request Event. Its digest is derived by decoding this suite-tagged full-digest EventId; no parallel request_digest is carried.

request_acceptance_receipt_core.description: Frozen original request confirmation, signed before the future round exists. initial_contact_round_id is present exactly after a first established identity; version is the holder lifetime Contact operation version. Recontact does not reset it.

contact_producer_signer.description: Exact-Event source-signed producer projection. Closed direct and delegated branches are distinguished by delegated_actor_did presence, with no new wire tag. Enclosing carrier validation MUST select delegated if and only if the original Event is a legal Agent controller-device Event with executed_by; human and Agent runtime use direct. Method/raw32 authenticate the original producer, while delegated_actor_did only locates the independently verified Agent public identity. No reusable authorization, new endpoint or private PCR disclosure is created.

public_key_base64url.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of the exact Ed25519 raw32 key independently verified by the source for this confirmed Contact Event.

contact_direct_producer_signer.description: Closed direct producer branch for human-device and Agent-runtime Contact Events. The original Event has no executed_by; its producer method already locates its Actor DID. No delegated_actor_did is permitted.

public_key_base64url.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of the exact Ed25519 raw32 key independently verified by the source for this confirmed Contact Event.

delegated_actor_did.description: Complete public DID locator of the exact Agent Event actor, frozen from the source-verified native identity binding when the original Event has executed_by. It is not the executor DID, a core-derived locator, or authorization.

contact_delegated_producer_signer.description: Closed delegated producer branch, required exactly for a legal Agent controller-device Contact Event with executed_by. The receiver verifies the original producer signature and separately validates this complete Agent DID history against exact actor/controller/Station and the create-locked tuple.

contact_peer_endpoint.description: Exact selector mechanically derived from the verified peer producer of the selected accepted Contact round. Not current Device or MLS authority. Omit when no verified source exists.

contact_round_basis.description: Immutable normal/glare establishment evidence. No freshness, terminal acknowledgement, or history-chain root traversal is encoded here.

contact_initial_identity.description: Unsigned deterministic preservation of the first confirmed establishment originals. Founder is derived from round; this is not a newly signed root certificate. Exact Event refs, original producer signatures and original source receipts MUST cross-match.

contact_scope_instance.description: One current continuous directional scope instance. Retaining a scope retains its grant Event; removal closes it and re-addition selects the new grant Event. No independent generation counter.

contact_operation_evidence.description: Exact original holder-signed Contact Event plus its original branch-specific source confirmation. Pending or rejected command units cannot produce this evidence.

contact_round_closure.description: Original source tombstone closing this exact round. The receiving holder does not replace its own operation head or increment its own version. Validate the inner source and producer independently.

contact_scope_interval.description: Exact requested historical scope instance and its first actual removal/tombstone, if closed. The source result binds the completeness of this interval at its cut. Missing evidence is unknown, never an open interval invented from current scope equality.

contact_current_material.description: Bounded source material for the exact pair. All current proof refs, scope origins, original source confirmations and producer keys cross-match. Pending/reject never fabricate a round; root is absent only before first establishment. The signed control result covers the full material. Historical intervals are exact-requested, not an enumeration.
